packageRules.description: A NuGet wildcard version (3.*) already takes every new minor and patch at restore time, so Renovate only proposes a new major for it. Left to itself, Renovate 44 'bumps' a wildcard by rounding the new minor down to a multiple of ten: Testcontainers 3.* became 3.1*, which only matches 3.1 and 3.10-3.19. Same leading number = not a major, whatever Renovate types it (see the cross-major guard in default.json)
